what: SAMPLE lessons for the 'What the market taught us' panel (tools/build_pillars.py) until research/learn/insights.json (session day-marketlearn) lands. Placeholders, not findings: the page shows a SAMPLE banner.

insights.text: SAMPLE · Quiet Asia ranges led to cleaner London sweeps; wide Asia ranges led to more stopped trades.
SAMPLE · Trades taken in the first 30 minutes after a news print had wider stops and smaller size.
SAMPLE · Fills at the 5m open slipped 9-15 ticks when price was running; the backtest now assumes 10.
SAMPLE · The 30-minute clock exit is where it earns; early exits cut the win rate.
SAMPLE · Bar data cannot stand in for real ticks: every bar proxy failed the pre-set bar.
